provenance: Unmodified pass-10 atlas; only explicit entries below are candidates. All other image regions are unregistered.

composition.placement: Compute both piecePorts endpoints. Draw in increasing world x for H or increasing world y for V. Align perpendicular source center 64px to the world centerline. Crop the last period at the second geometric endpoint. Do not rotate or mirror raster pixels.
composition.phase: World-fixed phase: source 0 aligns to integer multiples of 0.96 tiles along repeatAxis. Crop first and last repeats at actual piece endpoints.
composition.sampling: Use rect only as physical source; gutter is sampling extrusion. Clip output to installed segment length. Use the same world-to-screen transform for all pieces. Repair seams only for actual compatible runtime interfaces, once per joint.
composition.damage: Only intact condition 0 registered. Condition 1–3 overlays are pending. Do not silently label intact art as damage coverage.
composition.band: The source includes one integral reinforcement band per texture period. It is not the topology-owned joint sleeve; parent must assess this cadence in the runtime preview.

straight-basic@1/rotation=0/turn=0.portsDescribe: One repeat period. Installed exit is (spans*0.5,0) relative to piece anchor.

straight-basic@1/rotation=1/turn=0.portsDescribe: One repeat period. Installed exit is (0,spans*0.5) relative to piece anchor.

straight-basic@1/rotation=2/turn=0.portsDescribe: One repeat period. Installed exit is (-spans*0.5,0) relative to piece anchor.

straight-basic@1/rotation=3/turn=0.portsDescribe: One repeat period. Installed exit is (0,-spans*0.5) relative to piece anchor.
